t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two distinct groups of gnomes grouped together by colour (earth vs. non-earth tones). Gnomes in one of these two groups will give more benefits than the other group, however, the group that derives the highest benefit is not fixed across the duration of the experiment so it is important to try out both groups and choose the one which gives the biggest reward

vb_textbox.text: There are two distinct groups of gnomes (Group 1 = Green, Yellow, Orange, and Brown gnomes)(Group 2 = Pink,    Red,    Blue,      and Purple gnomes)Each colour gnome in group 1 brings you to the same forest (Group 1 forest). Each colour gnome in group 2 brings you to the same forest (Group 2 forest).The two groups bring you to different forests. At different points in the game one forest will return more mushrooms than the other (e.g., the Group 1 forest might start off with more mushrooms than the Group 2 forest).However, the forest that returns the most mushrooms can change so it is important that you try out the different groups during the experiment if the number of mushrooms starts to drop.
